items.title: 68091_Joe Turner oral history interview
items.q: Met Satchel Paige down in Florida... the baseball player.

ctx.x: And, uh, we left an' went back to Chicago, an' I left an' went down a' New Orleans. So, we played all through Baton Rouge. We played all parts of Louisiana. Played Mississippi, Arkansas. Played around all down thataway. Florida. Went into Florida. Played down in Florida for a long time, Met Satchel Paige down in Florida... the baseball player. The Nicholas Brothers. I forget now the prizefighter used to hang out down there all the time. Forget his name. He was a good fighter, too.

We all live in the Sir John Hotel. Had a big swimmin' pool there 'n' ever'thing. Ever'body be out'n't. An' they jus' be in the pool, havin' a good time. Played all up an' down. Went to Key West, Florida--as far as you can go. Had a...I had a band with me...Joe Houston ...his orchestry. He lives out here now. He been out here a long time. An' we worked together. We had a good time, an' we also played some nightclubs in a little ol' town they call Key West, Florida...in there somewhere.
